user.title: Add vehicle
user.description: Add a vehicle and choose whether to use a saved VNeTraffic account or sign in with a different account.

new_account.title: Sign in with another account
new_account.description: Enter the credentials of the VNeTraffic account used to look up this vehicle.

confirm_credentials.title: Account sign-in verified
confirm_credentials.description: VNeTraffic authenticated account {account} and issued an access token. Select Confirm to save this vehicle. No fine lookup was performed.

error.account_not_found: This saved account no longer exists. Select another account.
error.login_rejected: VNeTraffic rejected this sign-in. Check username, password or account status. No changes were saved.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach VNeTraffic. Credentials have not been verified or saved.
error.cannot_verify: VNeTraffic did not provide a usable sign-in result. No changes were saved.
error.credentials_missing: No saved credentials are available for this vehicle.

init.title: Change vehicle lookup account
init.description: Check the saved account password or switch this vehicle to another VNeTraffic account. Previous fine data is preserved.

new_account.title: Sign in with a different account

check_current.title: Check current account password
check_current.description: Select Submit to verify this vehicle’s current saved credentials using the VNeTraffic sign-in API. No fine lookup is performed.

confirm_account.title: Account sign-in verified
confirm_account.description: VNeTraffic authenticated account {account}. Select Confirm to use it for this vehicle. Existing data will be preserved.

error.account_not_found: This saved account no longer exists. Select another account.
error.login_rejected: VNeTraffic rejected this sign-in. Check username, password or account status. No changes were saved.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach VNeTraffic. Credentials have not been verified or saved.
error.cannot_verify: VNeTraffic did not provide a usable sign-in result. No changes were saved.
error.credentials_missing: No saved credentials are available for this vehicle.

abort.credentials_valid: Login successful: the saved account and password were accepted. Vehicle settings were not changed.
